headline.text: Unwrapped truffle found on L3 line — *one* piece escaped flow wrapper, caught before case pack.

summary: One unwrapped truffle discovered at L3 packaging 07:03 MT; operator caught before case pack. Eight pallets misprint labels on hold at L1 Sollich 3. Changeover sanitation gap at L1 Sollich 2 left product remnants under belts.

holds.title: 8 pallets misprint labels
holds.summary: Labeler photoeye misalignment caused wrong label placement on Sollich 3; 8 pallets isolated, additional pallets at Springville warehouse status unknown.
holds.status: On hold pending warehouse review and relabel/rework disposition.

food_safety.title: Unwrapped truffle on line
food_safety.summary: Single flow-wrapped truffle found without wrapper at pack area 07:03 MT; operator caught before case pack, isolated immediately.
food_safety.status: Resolved — piece removed, no product released; root cause unknown, single occurrence.

quality.title: Missing filling in ML4 bars
quality.summary: Low-weight caddies on ML4 packaging area — bars missing dark filling layer; all underweight 10-bar caddies pulled aside for inspection.
quality.status: Operators monitoring for missing-fill rejects; isolated caddies held pending QA disposition.

quality.title: Insufficient salt on S4 caramels
quality.summary: 3rd shift flagged caramels from 2nd shift with insufficient salt topping; shift lead inspected pallet and noted issue.
quality.status: Pallet checked by 3rd shift lead; no formal hold, FYI flag only.

sanitation.title: Product remnants under Sollich 2 belts
sanitation.summary: 12-gram candies and bags found under Matrix 6, 7, 8 belts during 23-gram changeover; prior product not fully cleared before restart.
sanitation.status: Resolved — area cleaned before resuming production; changeover checklist gap flagged.

opportunities.text: Review Sollich 2 changeover checklist to include under-belt inspection before restart — based on 12g remnants found during today's 23g setup.
Consider adding label position verification step after labeler sensor adjustments on Sollich 3 — based on 8 pallets misprinted after photoeye was knocked back.
Consider adding flow-wrap integrity check to ML4 de-molding station checklist — based on today's unwrapped piece that escaped detection until pack area.
